summary: Completion providers may use any single trigger character, e.g. `#` for tickets, not only `@` and `/`. The new provider option `triggers` sets a char's label, pill prefix and default pick behavior; `createCompletionSearch` takes a `source` filter per call.
howTo: Set `trigger: '#'` on a `ChatCompletionProvider` to open its list with `#`; add `triggers={[{ char: '#', label, prefix }]}` (memoized) to AiChatProvider only to change the defaults. Nothing changes without it: `@` and `/` keep their behavior.
